_doc: GS-2 ONE FACTION SET (chair ruling on G-SEAMS S2, the owner's 'Do these next', 2026-10-30; ODQ §934.101), one signed structural shift. The power factions are the factions: settlement.factions[] becomes a projection of powerStructure.factions (same names, members by each NPC's own factionAffiliation, no minted name, no draw), derived at assembleSettlement from the FINAL roster; conflicts are the power-faction pairs a rival or enemy tie crosses, drawn on a new named assembly child stream 'faction-conflicts'; generatePopulation loses the name-pick retry loop, the linkage scatter and the conflict draws (its npcs and relationships draw first and do not move). MEASURED BEFORE THE WRITE on the 1000-settlement lane sample gen1000v2 regenerated at the lane tip: 0 of 4,835 group names are not power names; conflict parties are power factions in 2,480 of 2,480; 0 same-party, 0 ungrounded; towns with a conflict 618 -> 755 (every town with a crossing tie, none without). Attribution, zero residue, measured at the integration tip b3d457b0 vs this lane: espionage-dormancy-fence 360 of 360 rows move and with factions, conflicts, powerStructure.conflicts, the retired linkage trace and the receipt's conflict/faction evidence entries removed all 360 hash identically; dossier-prose-manifest 784 rows (392 towns x 2 audiences) move and every moved cell is DS-GEN-2 (650 changed, 616 added, 74 removed). Also moved and hand-edited in this shift (unregistered): the fork registry's generatePopulation rows (factions and conflicts leave the step; corruptionPass no longer mutates factions) with generationForkCensus's control hash, chooser keys and unpinned draw count. The chair signs under the owner's delegation quoted below (vetoable); a successor chair does not inherit this signature.
